title: Reseed L2 init functions are external with no access modifier
description: Every live Beanstalk facet is guarded (Invariable + nonReentrant + role/owner where applicable). By contrast all L2 reseed initializers — ReseedSilo.init, ReseedField.init, ReseedBarn.init, ReseedBean.init, ReseedInternalBalances.init, ReseedSun.init, ReseedWhitelist.init — are declared `external` with NO access modifier (no onlyOwner, no LibDiamond.enforceIsContractOwner, no initializer). They perform privileged bulk global-state writes (per-account stalk/roots/deposits, global silo balances, field pods, fertilizer linked list). This is the maximal guard asymmetry in the codebase: the most state-powerful functions are the least guarded. In the standard EIP-2535 pattern these run once via diamondCut's _init delegatecall and their selectors are not added as facets, so they are not attacker-callable post-upgrade. The risk is contingent: if any init selector is mistakenly registered on the diamond, or diamondCut is itself reachable, an attacker re-runs init to re-write global accounting.
impact: If reachable as a live selector: permissionless re-execution of migration accounting (re-mint stalk/roots via the DT-001/DT-003 paths, re-zero global silo balances via DT-002), i.e. unbacked governance weight, stolen earned-Bean share, and accounting desync — Critical class. If correctly one-shot via diamondCut _init (expected), not externally reachable and the guard asymmetry is by-design for diamond initializers. Severity recorded as Medium pending the deployment/diamondCut wiring proof; cannot be cleared from source alone.

ite.intent: Restrict privileged one-shot migration accounting writes to the diamond owner / diamondCut init path
ite.technique: init functions ship with no access modifier, relying entirely on diamondCut wiring (one-shot delegatecall, selectors not registered) to be unreachable
ite.evasion: If an init selector is registered as a facet, or diamondCut is reachable by a non-owner, replay init to rewrite global stalk/roots/deposits

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.accts[*].stalk/roots/deposits, s.sys.silo.balances[*], s.sys.fields[*].pods, s.sys.fert.* (all bulk-rewritable if init is callable)
ice_chain.impact: Unbacked stalk/roots + accounting desync if init is reachable post-deploy
ice_chain.exploit_path: ATTACKER -> reseedX.init(crafted args) [ONLY IF selector registered or diamondCut reachable] -> overwrites global accounting -> downstream silo/governance consumers read corrupted state. Reachability cannot be proven from source; routed for human verification of the diamondCut/deploy wiring (overlaps ACCESS-001).
